function.name: read_iteration
function.description: Read a specific JSON file from a past iteration record. 'params' contains iter_type, summary, and parameter distributions; 'log_sl' contains log synthetic likelihood and per-biomarker components; 'violation_report' contains validity summary and per-issue, per-biomarker counts.

iteration.description: The iteration number to read. Check the iteration index in the prompt for available iterations and their types.

file.description: Logical file key: 'params' for iter_type/summary/params, 'log_sl' for synthetic likelihood diagnostics, 'violation_report' for validity summary and issue counts.
